title: Blueheel Dance Studio
gap: Prices for classes and choreography not stated
blurb: Guests learn to dance Latin, Ballroom, and Club dances such as Salsa, Swing, Tango, Cha Cha, and Bachata. The studio offers personalized wedding dance choreography with a complimentary 30-minute consultation for new wedding couples. They provide beginner drop-in classes and registered courses for various dance styles including West Coast Swing and Hustle.
